title: ml.evaluate_data_frame
description:
Evaluate data frame analytics.

The API packages together commonly used evaluation metrics for various types
of machine learning features. This has been designed for use on indexes
created by data frame analytics. Evaluation requires both a ground truth
field and an analytics result field to be present.

evaluation.description: Defines the type of evaluation you want to perform.

index.description: Defines the `index` in which the evaluation will be performed.

query.description: A query clause that retrieves a subset of data from the source index.
